title: E2E.Adversarial.Zip.Bomb.Reserve.2026-TESTGRP
description: 3 GiB of deflated zeros, run with the free-space reserve set 1 GiB under what the scratch disk holds and the ratio floor lifted past the bomb. The bomb runs short of room above the reserve, so the job waits for room, says so once, and is not refused; a job short of room always waits, however full the disk is. The lane cancels it once the wait is said.
